## `neuro.regExp.test`

Instance method on `RegExp.prototype`.

> Returns a Boolean value that indicates whether or not a pattern exists in a searched string.

## Signatures

```ts
test(input: { regExp: <receiver>; string: string; prompt?: string }): Promise<boolean>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `RegExp.prototype.test` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
